title: Solutions Engineer (CS)
description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career! 

We are looking for a hands-on Solutions Engineer to help customers and internal teams explore what Cirrus Logic’s technologies can do in Automotive and Industrial applications. You will turn product capabilities and emerging customer needs into working solutions, proofs of concept, and compelling technical demonstrations.

This role, based in our Edinburgh office, combines electronic design, software, system integration, and practical problem-solving. You will develop and deliver working solutions that demonstrate the benefits of Cirrus Logic technologies, taking ownership of technical work from concept and prototyping through system integration, evaluation, and demonstration. You will collaborate with design, applications, systems, marketing, customers, and external partners


Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop system-level solutions and demonstrations using Cirrus Logic products across Automotive and Industrial applications.
  • Translate customer needs, use cases, and product capabilities into practical technical concepts and proofs of concept.
  • Design, prototype, bring up, and debug electronic hardware, including PCBs, evaluation boards, and supporting circuitry.
  • Integrate ICs, sensors, embedded software, signal paths, communications interfaces, and mechanical components into complete working systems.
  • Develop or adapt software, scripts, and basic user interfaces to configure, control, test, and demonstrate systems.
  • Plan and carry out evaluations, investigate system-level issues, and use measurements and hands-on assessment to guide improvements.
  • Work with internal engineering teams and external partners to define requirements, coordinate technical work, and deliver functional prototypes and demonstrations.
  • Prepare clear setup guides, technical documentation, and presentation materials so others can evaluate, operate, and explain the solutions.
  • Support customer engagements, internal reviews, and industry events by demonstrating solutions and explaining their technical value.
  • Travel internationally to support customers, tradeshows, and other business activities, expected to be approximately 4–6 weeks per year.
  • Contribute to the mechanical design and integration of prototypes and demonstrations, working with internal specialists or external partners where needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • A degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience developing and debugging electronic systems that combine hardware and software.
  • PCB design experience, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, prototype bring-up, and verification.
  • Confidence using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies, and signal generators.
  • Practical software skills sufficient to get prototypes and demonstrations working, including writing or adapting scripts, configuring embedded platforms, integrating APIs, and debugging hardware–software interactions.
  • The ability to use AI-assisted software development tools effectively, while reviewing, testing, and troubleshooting the resulting code.
  • Familiarity with common hardware interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, and audio interfaces such as I²S or TDM.
  • A methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to move from a system-level symptom to a practical solution.
  • The ability to take ownership of deliverables, manage competing priorities, and make sound engineering decisions.
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical work to people from different disciplines.
  • A willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to develop practical solutions.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience with Automotive or Industrial electronic systems, semiconductor products, or mixed-signal applications.
  • Familiarity with one or more relevant technology areas, such as audio, haptics, sensing, clocking and synchronisation, or power management, and their integration into practical systems.
  • Experience developing prototypes, proofs of concept, evaluation platforms, or customer-facing demonstrations.
  • Knowledge of networking and communications technologies used in Automotive or Industrial systems, such as Ethernet, CAN, LIN, EtherCAT, or PROFINET.
  • Familiarity with single-pair Ethernet technologies, such as 100BASE-T1, 10BASE-T1S, or 10BASE-T1L.
  • Experience working with OEMs, system integrators, Tier 1 suppliers, or external development partners.
  • Familiarity with relevant functional safety, qualification, or electromagnetic compatibility standards, such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, AEC-Q100, or CISPR 25.
  • Experience with mechanical design and integration, including basic CAD, enclosures, fixtures, mounting arrangements, and rapid prototyping techniques such as 3D printing.
  • Experience with system architecture, product definition, feasibility studies, teardowns, or competitive analysis.

This role is based in our Edinburgh, UK office.

This is a hybrid position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. You must be based within commutable distance of the work location listed on the job posting, or willing to relocate prior to beginning employment with Cirrus Logic.

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
description:
Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

Software engineering is being redefined. The engineers who will shape the next decade of product development are not the ones who write the most code — they are the ones who know how to think clearly, ship confidently, and use every tool available to them, including AI, to multiply their impact.

The Actian Data Intelligence Platform helps teams find, understand, and use AI-ready data under clear governance. It connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, so enterprises can turn raw data into reliable decisions — the trusted foundation that AI agents increasingly depend on to work. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Data Intelligence Platform has to deploy, operate, and pass audits in every one of the environments our customers run — public cloud, private cloud, and on-premises. We are standing up a dedicated platform team to make that possible, and we are hiring the leader who will build it.

This is a hands-on director role. You will stand up and lead a newly formed platform team, hire and grow it, and build alongside it from day one: you will design the platform services, write infrastructure code, and set the engineering standards the rest of engineering relies on.

We are an AI-first engineering organization, and in this role AI is how the work gets done. AI agents run operational tasks, AI accelerates the team's own engineering, and AI replaces tools we pay for today but no longer need. You will also build the infrastructure that runs the AI and ML workloads inside our product.

 


What You Will Own:

  • Platform services for the Data Intelligence Platform, including the infrastructure behind the data catalog, the knowledge graph, and the APIs that power customer integrations.

  • Cloud-agnostic deployment of the Platform across AWS, a second public cloud (Azure or Google Cloud), and customer on-premises and private-cloud environments — including packaging, installation, upgrades, and supportability.

  • The internal developer platform and CI/CD, including GitOps delivery, so engineering teams ship safely and quickly.

  • Security operations and compliance evidence for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR — including EU data residency — in partnership with the security team.

  • Cloud cost management and FinOps, with clear cost visibility and accountability across every environment.

  • Infrastructure for the AI and ML workloads used by the Platform.

  • Observability, reliability, and incident response for the services the team runs, including the team's on-call rotation.

  • Building and growing the team — hiring platform engineers, setting the operating model, and establishing the standards and rituals the team works by.

Parce que vous participerez à la construction de notre stratégie d’intelligence artificielle, que nous sommes en train de définir.

Éléments clés

  • Concevoir des solutions RAG et agentiques appliquées à des cas d’usage métier concrets.

  • Contribuer directement au workflow de paramétrage produit KELIA, avec une validation humaine intégrée aux étapes clés.
  • Participer à la mise en production des assistants, de leur API jusqu’à leur intégration dans l’interface web interne.


Ce qu’il faut savoir :

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur Python IA pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D à Paris ou Lille

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions, de la conception jusqu’à la mise en production, en mobilisant différentes approches : modèles de langage (LLM), apprentissage supervisé, clustering et autres techniques de machine Learning.

Un volet important de la mission concerne également le paramétrage produit : l’objectif est d’extraire les informations pertinentes des conditions générales, de proposer un paramétrage, de prévoir une validation par un expert à chaque étape et de produire un fichier directement importable dans KELIA.

Missions principales :

Vous développez en Python des fonctionnalités IA.

  • Ingestion documentaire : extraire le texte et les tableaux des PDF, des pages Confluence, des documents SharePoint et des dépôts GitLab, puis découper, indexer et mettre à jour ces contenus avec des jobs asynchrones.
  • Recherche : recherche hybride (sémantique et mots-clés), filtres par collection et par chemin, reranking, et recherche visuelle sur les pages de documents.
  • Agents et LLM : développer des agents avec LangGraph (routage, recherche, filtrage, réflexion, réponse), écrire et versionner les prompts, citer les sources, et répondre « je ne trouve pas » quand l'information manque.
  • Workflow de paramétrage produit : contribuer à l'agent qui extrait les informations des conditions générales, propose le paramétrage, fait valider chaque étape par un expert et produit un fichier importable dans KELIA.
  • Qualité : maintenir des jeux de tests, mesurer le taux de bonnes réponses, suivre les réponses inventées et vérifier que les résultats sont stables d'un run à l'autre.
  • Coût et latence : suivre la consommation de tokens, le temps de première réponse et le cache, et choisir le bon modèle pour chaque tâche.
  • API : exposer les assistants en API, avec des réponses en streaming, et les intégrer à l'interface web interne.
  • Documenter votre code, écrire des tests et participer aux revues de code.

  • Vous avez une expérience ou un réel intérêt pour les solutions d’IA générative, les LLM et les architectures agentiques avec LangChain, LangGraph et LiteLLM.
  • Vous connaissez les principes de RAG, de recherche hybride, d’embeddings et de reranking, idéalement avec Qdrant.
  • Vous savez travailler avec des sources documentaires variées et leur ingestion, notamment des PDF, Confluence, SharePoint ou GitLab, avec des outils tels que Docling.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les environnements de stockage et de persistance reposant sur PostgreSQL et le stockage objet S3.
  • Vous accordez de l’importance à l’observabilité et à la qualité des solutions IA, notamment au suivi des prompts, des traces, des logs, des coûts et des performances, avec des outils comme MLflow.
  • Vous êtes sensibilisé aux enjeux de sécurité, d’authentification et de gestion des rôles, notamment avec Keycloak.
  • Vous évoluez avec aisance dans un environnement d’industrialisation moderne utilisant Git, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm et pytest, ainsi que des outils collaboratifs comme Jira et Confluence.

  • Votre compréhension du fonctionnement d'un RAG : embeddings, découpage, recherche, génération.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du SQL et notions de bases de données.
  • Git et travail en équipe.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

title: GPU Engineer
description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.


What excites you

  • Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

  • Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

  • Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

  • Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

  • Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

  • Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

  • Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

  • Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

  • Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

  • Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

  • Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

  • Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

  • A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

  • Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

  • Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

  • Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

  • Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

  • Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

  • A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

title: Head of AI
description:
About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

  • Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

  • Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

  • Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

  • Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

  • Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

  • Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.


About You

  • You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

  • You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

  • You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

  • You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

  • You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

  • Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment.

  • Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

  • A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

  • The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

  • A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

  • The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have:

  • Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

  • Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

  • Experience with MDSAP

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

title: Afstudeerstage | Marketing & Propositieontwikkeling
description:
Hoe vertaal je marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar sterke proposities die zichtbaar zijn en commerciële kansen creëren? Tijdens deze hbo- of wo-afstudeerstage bij Risk Solutions, onderdeel van Centric, ga je aan de slag met een uitdagend vraagstuk waarin marketing, propositieontwikkeling, business development en procesoptimalisatie samenkomen.

Risk Solutions ondersteunt organisaties bij het beheersen van financiële, operationele en compliance-risico’s. Denk aan oplossingen en dienstverlening rondom kredietacceptatie, risicobeoordeling, Wwft, AML, KYC en fraudebeheersing. Er is veel kennis aanwezig over de markt, klanten, risico’s en wetgeving. De uitdaging is om deze kennis te vertalen naar duidelijke proposities en gerichte commerciële en marketingactiviteiten.

Jouw afstudeeropdracht

Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. Je kijkt waar het proces beter of efficiënter kan en werkt daarbij samen met collega’s uit onder andere Marketing, Sales, Business Consultancy, Compliance en Risk Management.

De centrale vraag tijdens jouw afstudeerstage is: Hoe kan Risk Solutions het marketing- en propositieproces zo inrichten dat nieuwe proposities met beperkte capaciteit sneller en consistenter in de markt worden gezet en de zichtbaarheid, vindbaarheid en commerciële opvolging worden verbeterd?

Je onderzoekt ook wat er in de markt speelt en hoe andere aanbieders hun oplossingen presenteren. Daarbij verdiep je je onder andere in kredietacceptatie, financiële risico’s, AML, Wwft, KYC en fraudepreventie. Je onderzoekt welke financiële, commerciële en compliancevraagstukken bij klanten spelen, hoe organisaties daarmee omgaan en welke waarde verschillende oplossingen daarbij bieden. Ook kijk je naar wat belangrijk is voor bijvoorbeeld een Compliance Officer, Risk Manager, kredietmanager of directielid.

Daarnaast onderzoek je de zichtbaarheid van de verschillende proposities. Je kijkt hoe kanalen en middelen zoals de website, SEO, LinkedIn, klantcases, whitepapers, nieuwsbrieven, webinars en evenementen worden ingezet en waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Ook onderzoek je welke werkzaamheden slimmer kunnen worden ingericht en waar AI kan ondersteunen.

Op basis van je onderzoek ontwikkel je een Marketing & Proposition Launch Framework. Hierin leg je een vaste werkwijze vast om een propositie van idee en positionering naar content, campagne, leadopvolging en evaluatie te brengen. Je maakt hiervoor praktische hulpmiddelen, zoals templates voor proposities en campagnes, afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om resultaten te meten.

Tijdens je stage test je deze werkwijze op minimaal één concrete propositie. Samen met de betrokken collega’s doorloop je de verschillende stappen en maak je bijvoorbeeld een propositiecanvas, contentplan, campagne-opzet of salesmateriaal. Op basis van wat je in de praktijk tegenkomt, pas je de werkwijze aan. Zo ligt er aan het einde van je stage een aanpak die het team daarna zelf kan blijven gebruiken.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je analyseert het huidige proces, van marktontwikkeling en propositie tot campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe proposities het beste in de markt kunnen worden gezet en welke content en kanalen bijdragen aan meer zichtbaarheid en vindbaarheid.

  • Je kijkt hoe AI en automatisering kunnen helpen om werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren.

Je sluit je stage af met meer dan alleen een onderzoeksrapport. Je levert een geteste en praktische werkwijze op die het team daarna kan blijven gebruiken, inclusief hulpmiddelen, duidelijke afspraken over rollen en verantwoordelijkheden en KPI’s om de resultaten te volgen.

title: [Interim] Strategy & Transformation Lead (CTO office)
description:
(Interim) Strategy & Transformation Lead (CTO office) 

Freelance | Hybrid, Netherlands | Interim, immediate start 

Riverflex is supporting technology leaders at major retailers through a number of strategic engagements, and we are looking for experienced strategy consultants to join our team on an interim basis. You work as part of a Riverflex team alongside our in-house consultants, reporting to a member of our leadership team. You help CTOs shape how their technology organisations run, decide and deliver.

Current and upcoming opportunities include:

  • Supporting a CTO following the merger of regional technology departments into one. The work covers how the leadership team should operate and how to set up a CTO office that delivers on their ambitions.

  • Partner with CTO-1 leadership to shape, document and drive the convergence plan following the merger of regional technology departments.

  • Establishing an AI-enabled CTO office. This means rethinking processes and ways of working, and using AI solutions to make the office more effective.

  • Acting as strategic thinking partner to a CTO. This means answering key technology questions and preparing updates for the C-suite.

  • Supporting CTO to drive improvements and modernization of security and disaster recovery strategy.

  • Support a large-scale, multi-country data transformation by setting up an EU-level DMO and governance model that aligns priorities, decision-making and delivery across regions.

You bring top-tier consulting training and sharp problem-solving skills. You structure ambiguous questions, build the analysis and craft the storyline. You do this as part of a tight team, not as a solo act.

About Riverflex 

Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018, eventually growing into a global team of consultants united by a mission to help courageous leaders drive transformative change. Today, we offer an integrated service through three service pillars: strategy and transformation consulting that Creates Change, talent services that Build Teams, and business-accelerating products that Augment Intelligence. For more information, visit www.riverflex.com.

Responsibilities 

  • You break down strategic technology questions into clear problem statements, hypotheses and workplans

  • You help design technology operating models, including leadership team set-up, governance, CTO office structure, processes and ways of working

  • You run the analysis: fact-finding, stakeholder interviews, data gathering and synthesis into clear recommendations

  • You build executive-ready storylines and materials for CTO and C-suite audiences

  • You build trusted working relationships with senior client stakeholders across technology and the business

  • You get up to speed quickly and add value from week one

Job requirements 

  • 8 - 10 years’ experience, including a strong grounding in strategy or technology consulting at an MBB or Big 4 firm

  • Proven experience on technology strategy, operating model or transformation work at senior level

  • Excellent structured problem-solving and hypothesis-driven thinking

  • Strong executive communication, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear C-suite narrative

  • A collaborative, low-ego working style and comfort working within a team led by Riverflex leadership

  • Availability to start immediately

  • Based in the Netherlands, or able to be on site regularly

  • Fluent English and EU work authorisation

The following are a plus for our different open opportunities:

  • Experience designing or setting up a CTO office, or integrating technology functions after a merger

  • Exposure to AI-enabled ways of working or process redesign

  • Expertise in Cyber Security and Disaster Recovery

Why this role 

You work at CTO and C-suite level on questions that shape how major retailers run technology. You join an experienced Riverflex team from day one, with real input into the thinking and the outputs. title: Technical Integrations Manager
description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

  • Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

  • Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

  • Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

  • Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

  • Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

  • Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

  • Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

  • Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:

  • You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

  • You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

  • You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

  • You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

  • You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

  • You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

  • Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

  • You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

  • A budget for your dream home office;

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About The Role

As the Deployed Engineering Manager for Northern Europe, you will lead a team of deployed engineers from our hub in Amsterdam, working with our customers across DACH and Benelux. You'll help build and shape the team, grow the people in it and make sure our customers get the technical partnership they need to build and run great agents in production. This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company shaping the future of AI-powered software.

DEs work alongside our sales team to help our prospects and customers build reliable, scalable agents for their business using our suite of products: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith. The team focuses on pre-sales efforts, but stays on accounts to not only close new business but also to make our customers wildly successful.

Your first job is your people. You will support great deployed engineers, ramp them quickly, coach them through live customer work and build a team where they do the best work of their careers. You'll stay close enough to the technology and to our customers to be credible with both: unblocking your team on hard engagements and stepping in on the region's most important opportunities.

You will report to the Director of Deployed Engineering, EMEA and partner closely with LangChain's sales leaders covering DACH and Benelux, with shared ownership of regional outcomes.

This role is mostly people leadership, with real customer engagement and revenue accountability alongside it. As part of the EMEA deployed engineering leadership team, you'll also bring what you learn back into the playbooks, processes and standards we use globally.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow the DACH/Benelux DE team: support recruiting, interviewing and closing candidates as the team grows and raise the bar with every hire.

  • Onboard and ramp new DEs quickly, with a clear definition of what "ramped" looks like and the support to get each person there.

  • Coach your team through live customer work: join calls, review architectures and proofs of value to provide direct, specific feedback that makes people better.

  • Own performance management: set clear expectations, recognise great work and address underperformance early and fairly.

  • Run the team's operating rhythm: account coverage, capacity and load balancing, deal and engagement reviews and the regional cadence with sales.

  • Partner with sales leadership in DACH and the Benelux on account strategy, coverage and technical win plans, with shared accountability for revenue outcomes and customer success.

  • Bring regional insight to the global DE team: what's working with customers in the region, product feedback and contributions to shared playbooks.

  • Develop future leaders, growing the senior DEs who will lead the next teams in the region.

  • 7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles at a dev tools, AI, or infrastructure company.

  • 2+ years managing customer-facing engineers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

  • A track record of developing people: engineers you hired and grew who went on to bigger scope or roles.

  • Technical credibility with your team and your customers: you're not a stranger to Python, and are well-versed in software engineering, platform engineering and solutions architecture. Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agents is a strong plus.

  • Experience working with or selling to developers and engineering-led buyers and an understanding of how enterprises in the region evaluate and buy (procurement, data protection, hosting and sovereignty requirements).

  • Exceptional communication and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers and coach others to do the same.

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a consistently high bar for excellence.

  • Fluent English; German strongly preferred.

  • Must be available to work in Amsterdam, with regular travel across the region.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

title: Senior Corporate Recruiter

description:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider HR: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!
